system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I just made an account—mei_patel_7272—and placed some orders, but I think I might have typed my address wrong. Can you help me check what address is on my account and orders? If it’s wrong, I’d like to fix it everywhere.

Also, I ordered a jigsaw puzzle, but I want to see if I can switch it to the easiest one you have, with the least pieces, since it’s for my little kid. I usually pay with PayPal. Thanks!

I can help with that — first I need to authenticate you. Please provide either:

- the email on your account (preferred), or  
- your first name, last name, and zip code.

A few things to confirm so I handle this correctly:
- Do you want me to check the default account address and all your orders? (I’ll list what’s on file.)  
- If the address is wrong, do you want me to update the default account address AND update shipping on all pending orders that still can be changed? (Note: only pending orders can have shipping changed; processed/delivered orders cannot be updated.)  
- For the jigsaw puzzle: do you know the order id, or should I look through your orders to find it? If it’s a pending order I can try to switch the item to a different variant (must be same product type); I’ll check availability and any price difference. You said you usually pay with PayPal — confirm you want PayPal used for any price difference or refund.

Once you provide your email (or name+zip) I’ll look up your account and orders and report back the addresses and the puzzle order details.

Sure, my name is Mei Patel and my zip code is 76165.

Yes, please check the default account address and all my orders. If the address is wrong, I’d like to update it everywhere you can—both the account and any orders that haven’t shipped yet.

I don’t remember the order ID for the jigsaw, so please look through my orders to find it. If it hasn’t shipped, I’d like to switch it to the easiest puzzle you have, and use PayPal for any price difference or refund.

Thanks for your help!
